end.summary:
- Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects; some answers were right, but naming was not steady yet.
- Practised sorting solids by flat faces, curved faces or both; some answers were right, but this was not steady yet.
- Aditya identified a die as a cube because it has corners.
- Aditya mixed up a matchbox as a cube and a cuboid; the mix-up was still present at the last time it was seen.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming solid shapes in toys and objects, and sorting them by flat and curved faces. Aditya used the die’s corners to identify a cube and described circular faces on a cylinder and a smaller flat face on a cone. The matchbox was called both a cube and a cuboid during the lesson, and the cube mix-up was still present at the last time it was seen. At home, compare a die and a matchbox by checking whether all their faces are equal squares or whether the box is longer.
